title: Passive Potassium Dynamics
description: A single passive potassium current relaxes the membrane back toward E_K after current injection.

title: Passive Na + K Dynamics
description: Constant Na and K conductances pull voltage toward a weighted balance between E_Na and E_K.

title: Smooth Voltage-Dependent Na Conductance
description: Na conductance rises smoothly with depolarization, sharpening the response to stronger inputs.

title: Na Activation + Inactivation
description: Sodium activation m and inactivation h create a transient inward current during sustained stimulation.

title: Active Na + K Conductance
description: Add delayed potassium activation n to create a more spike-like interaction between inward and outward currents.

title: Na + K + Leak Conductance
description: A simplified Hodgkin-Huxley-style model with Na, K, and leak conductances produces full action-potential dynamics.
